name: hexanedinitrile
notes: Primary ThermoML observation confirmed at 298.15 K: eps=32.12 +/- 0.1, pure component, zero frequency, dataset 3, DOI 10.1021/je300958c. ECW-308 Table S3 lists this compound with a value of 30.00 at 25 C citing Duncan, Salem & Abu-Lebdeh, J. Electrochem. Soc. 2013, 160, A838 (DOI 10.1149/2.088306jes). That cited table was retrieved on 2026-09-24 from the NRC Publications Archive accepted manuscript (record 431ad01c-3fb7-4610-923b-99d08c6a4c16): Table I on p. A840 reports the compound as eps=30, not 30.00, so the two decimals in ECW-308 are unsupported precision rather than a second measurement. The paper records that dielectric constants were measured with a Brookhaven BI-870 meter, but Table I carries no per-row provenance, temperature, frequency or uncertainty, so the value cannot be promoted to a same-condition primary cross-check. It sits about 6.6% below the retained primary observation and is recorded as a source disagreement rather than an error. The values were not averaged.

The row stays conflict_open because a Knovel Critical Tables-derived interval of 78-127 disagrees. Vinylene carbonate melts near 295 K, so the 298 K observation sits close to the melting point.

name: 3-methoxypropionitrile
notes: Value 36.00 at 25 C was read from the ECW-308 battery-solvent compilation (Wang et al. 2023, Adv. Funct. Mater., DOI 10.1002/adfm.202212342, Table S3, rows 43 and 51), which cites Perricone et al. (2013) Electrochim. Acta 93, 1 (DOI 10.1016/j.electacta.2013.01.084). The cited paper is closed access, but the same first author's open-access doctoral thesis (Perricone 2011, Universite de Grenoble, NNT 2011GRENI032, HAL tel-00630049), Tableau 12 on page 65, lists epsilon_r = 36 for methoxypropionitrile, so the number is citable to a document a reader can open. The thesis states no temperature and belongs to the same research line, so this is document-level corroboration, not a second measurement: the value stays a secondary compilation and the row is deliberately held out of the model-ready set. The publisher supplementary file and the thesis PDF are not redistributable; only the numeric facts are recorded. Adversarial Table S3 review also found that row 51's dielectric cell contains a stacked 25.00 value without a separate citation; the cited main value 36.00 is retained, and 25.00 is recorded as a multi-value warning rather than averaged or promoted.
